response.sql: SELECT AVG(got_gpt_avg) as avg_got_gpt, AVG(appt_pt_avg) as avg_appt_pt FROM (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CASE WHEN GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL THEN GOT - GPT END) as got_gpt_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL THEN APTT - PT END) as appt_pt_avg FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) subquery
